overview:
This 8 day Tarangire Ngorongoro and Serengeti safari is a 7-night northern Tanzania trip from Kilimanjaro Airport: 1 night at Serval Wildlife, 1 near Tarangire, 1 at Lake Manyara, 3 in the Serengeti and 1 at the Ngorongoro Crater. The Serengeti days follow the Great Migration wherever the herds are. It costs from USD 6,180 per adult and USD 4,368 per child, and suits couples and families.

It suits travellers who want comfortable lodges, a private 4WD Land Cruiser and extra activities such as cycling, a Maasai village visit, a canoe ride and a night game drive, all on full board with an English or bilingual driver-guide.

Why choose an 8 day Tarangire Ngorongoro and Serengeti safari?

This Tarangire, Ngorongoro and Serengeti safari covers the four big parks of the northern circuit with time to enjoy each one. Tarangire is known for its elephant herds and baobab trees, Lake Manyara for its groundwater forest and tree-climbing lions, and the Ngorongoro Crater for black rhino.

The Serengeti gets 3 nights and two full days, so your guide can drive to wherever the wildebeest and zebra herds are, from the calving plains in the south to the river crossings in the north. A sundowner on the Serengeti plains is included.

  • Families: a gentle start at Serval Wildlife and a cycling and village day at Mto wa Mbu.
  • Migration seekers: two full Serengeti days planned around the herds.
  • Comfort lovers: lodges such as Mbali Mbali Soroi Serengeti Lodge and Ngorongoro Oldeani Mountain Lodge.

What to expect on the 8 day Tarangire Ngorongoro and Serengeti safari

Day 1 starts at Kilimanjaro International Airport with a transfer of about 2 hours, an up-close wildlife experience at Serval Wildlife and a night at Serval Wildlife Villas. Day 2 is about 3 hours' drive to Tarangire National Park for elephants, baobabs and a picnic by the Tarangire River, then a night at Manyara Secret Lodge or Escarpment Luxury Lodge Manyara.

Day 3 is spent around Mto wa Mbu, about 2 hours away, with cycling, a Maasai village visit, an evening canoe ride and a night game drive in Lake Manyara National Park, then a night at Lake Manyara Kilimamoja Lodge. Day 4 is about 5 hours' drive through the Ngorongoro Conservation Area to the Serengeti, with an afternoon game drive.

Days 5 and 6 are full Serengeti game drives following the migration, with nights at Mbali Mbali Soroi Serengeti Lodge or Melia Serengeti Lodge. Day 7 is about 4 hours to the Ngorongoro Crater for a picnic by a hippo pool and a crater game drive, then a night at Ngorongoro Oldeani Mountain Lodge or Melia Ngorongoro Crater. Day 8 is about 4 hours back to Kilimanjaro Airport.

When is the best time for a Serengeti migration safari?

The Serengeti migration can be seen all year because the herds move in a loop. Calving on the southern plains usually peaks around January to March, and the river crossings in the north usually happen from about July to October. This itinerary changes its Serengeti game drives to match the season. Read our Serengeti migration guide to pick your dates.

What is included in this Tarangire, Ngorongoro and Serengeti safari?

The price includes a meet and greet with a safari briefing, all transport in a 4WD Land Cruiser, 7 nights' accommodation on full board, all park entry and conservation fees, an English or bilingual driver-guide, unlimited game drives on the itinerary with drinking water, the Lake Manyara night game drive, cycling, the Maasai village visit, the canoe ride and a sundowner on the Serengeti plains.

Not included are international flights, visas, travel insurance, the Serengeti hot air balloon flight, tips (about USD 10 per person per day is suggested), drinks and personal items. Read our Lake Manyara National Park guide and our Ngorongoro Crater lodges guide, or see the lower-priced 8 day great migration northern Tanzania safari.
